item.title: Tech investment fuelling confidence among Yorkshire businesses - KPMG
item.description: The vast majority of private businesses in Yorkshire feel confident about their growth prospects for 2026 with technology investment expected to be a key driver, according to research by KPMG.

item.title: Demand for services fuels growth optimism among South East businesses - KPMG
item.description: More than four in five private firms in the South East have entered 2026 with strong confidence and clear growth ambitions, according to KPMG's annual Private Enterprise Barometer.

item.title: Tekmar lands £4m contract for offshore wind project in Europe
item.description: Newton Aycliffe-based Tekmar Group has secured a £4m contract for a European offshore wind project.

item.title: Former president of Queens' College in Cambridge to chair County Durham firm
item.description: A former president of Queens' College in Cambridge has been appointed chair of County Durham-headquartered Graphene Composites.

item.title: Silverstone Building Consultancy completes new super branch for Newcastle Building Society
item.description: Silverstone Building Consultancy has completed the multimillion-pound refurbishment of a grade II-listed building, paving the way for a UK super bank for Newcastle Building Society.
